Hi Hugo! `parse_movement_line` uses `parse_quantity`, which applies the case size for 'CS' units. So '1 CS' with a case size of 6 will return 6 eaches (or -6 for SHP). If your acceptance tests expect 1, they might be using a case size of 1 or they might be incorrect.
